$comment: The 38 chaos flags from 05-FUNCTIONALITY.md § 11, as data. GET /admin/chaos serves this verbatim, which is what lets the admin UI render every flag without a hardcoded list -- and what makes adding a flag a one-line change here rather than a change in two places that drift apart.

flags.name: gds_latency_ms
flags.injection: mock-gds, before responding; additive to the baseline distribution

flags.name: gds_latency_mode
flags.injection: How the delay is applied

flags.name: gds_error_rate
flags.injection: mock-gds returns 503

flags.name: gds_provider_down
flags.injection: One provider always times out, producing partial results

flags.name: gds_rate_limit_aggressive
flags.injection: The per-provider rate limit drops from 60 to 10 requests a minute

flags.name: payment_latency_ms
flags.injection: mock-payments, before responding

flags.name: payment_error_rate
flags.injection: mock-payments returns 500 -- an ERROR, not a decline

flags.name: payment_decline_rate
flags.injection: Decline rate; a business outcome rather than a fault

flags.name: payment_decline_mix
flags.injection: Which decline code dominates

flags.name: payment_webhook_delay_ms
flags.injection: Delay before the asynchronous authorization webhook fires

flags.name: email_failure_rate
flags.injection: mock-email returns 422, generating DLQ traffic

flags.name: db_n_plus_one
flags.injection: booking-service loops the booking-list query instead of joining

flags.name: db_drop_index
flags.injection: Drops idx_bookings_user_id_created_at; reset recreates it

flags.name: db_lock_storm
flags.injection: A background task holds a row lock on inventory_holds, five seconds at a time

flags.name: db_pool_starvation
flags.injection: The SQLAlchemy pool shrinks to two connections
flags.compensating: Pool is resized back to 10 on reset

flags.name: db_slow_query_ms
flags.injection: Adds pg_sleep() to one reporting query -- the one honest use of sleep, emulating a genuinely expensive analytical query

flags.name: redis_disabled
flags.injection: All cache reads miss and writes are skipped

flags.name: redis_latency_ms
flags.injection: Delay before every Redis operation

flags.name: cache_ttl_seconds
flags.injection: Search-result TTL; set to 1 for near-constant misses

flags.name: kafka_consumer_pause
flags.injection: Pauses that consumer group, producing real and growing lag

flags.name: kafka_slow_consumer_ms
flags.injection: Per-message processing delay

flags.name: kafka_producer_error_rate
flags.injection: Producer send failures

flags.name: kafka_poison_rate
flags.injection: Emits malformed messages, which the consumer routes to the DLQ

flags.name: pricing_hot_path
flags.injection: Bypasses the fare-rule index, evaluating every rule with a regex compiled inside the loop

flags.name: booking_memory_leak
flags.injection: A module-level dict retains confirmed itineraries and never evicts them
flags.compensating: The retained cache is cleared on reset, but a process that has already OOMed needs a single-service restart

flags.name: hold_lock_contention
flags.injection: Widens the advisory-lock critical section around an inventory hold

flags.name: service_error_rate
flags.injection: Per-service synthetic 500s, as a service-to-rate object

flags.name: service_latency_ms
flags.injection: Per-service added latency, as a service-to-milliseconds object

flags.name: frontend_heavy_assets
flags.injection: Serves large images everywhere and disables lazy loading, collapsing LCP

flags.name: frontend_blocking_js
flags.injection: A synchronous 400 ms main-thread task on results render, collapsing INP

flags.name: frontend_js_error_rate
flags.injection: Random client-side exceptions

flags.name: frontend_layout_shift
flags.injection: A delayed-insert banner, regressing CLS

flags.name: llm_latency_ms
flags.injection: Added time to first token

flags.name: llm_degrade_tools
flags.injection: The model returns prose instead of a tool call

flags.name: llm_hallucinate
flags.injection: The model invents a plausible-but-wrong PNR and itinerary. Never touches the booking record.

flags.name: llm_error_rate
flags.injection: mock-llm returns 500

flags.name: llm_token_bloat
flags.injection: Verbose responses, producing a visible token and cost spike

flags.name: version_override
flags.injection: Overrides the reported DD_VERSION to fake a deploy
